recipe.title: Chef's Signature Golden Egg Fried Rice
recipe.description: A refined Cantonese-style golden fried rice where egg yolks coat every grain of fragrant rice, elevated with toasted garlic, butter, and caramelized soy sauce.

instructions.text: Separate 2 egg yolks from their whites. In a large bowl, combine the 2 egg yolks with cold leftover rice, mixing thoroughly until every grain is coated in a vibrant golden hue. Whisk the leftover egg whites together with the 1 remaining whole egg in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tablespoon of neutral oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Pour in the whisked egg mixture and scramble gently until just soft-set. Remove from the pan and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil and butter to the hot pan. Add the minced garlic and the white stems of the chopped scallions; stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Increase heat to high and add the yolk-coated rice. Stir-fry vigorously, breaking up any clumps, for 3 to 4 minutes until the rice becomes hot, fluffy, and fragrant.
Drizzle soy sauce along the hot edges of the pan so it caramelizes instantly, then toss to integrate evenly with the rice. Season with white pepper and salt.
Fold the soft-scrambled eggs and reserved green scallion tops back into the rice. Remove from heat, finish with a drizzle of toasted sesame oil, and serve hot.

tips: Coating cold rice with raw egg yolks prior to cooking creates non-sticky, distinct grains with a beautiful golden color.
Drizzling soy sauce onto the scorching metal sides of the pan caramelizes the sauce, imparting an essential smoky 'wok hei' flavor.
